items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: Did you have a band with Clarence Ford?

ctx.x: My mother told her she want to play piano. She started paying for her to take piano lessons. But Margie wouldn't practice. They had to whip her to make her practice. a trumpet, you won't have to whip me to make me practice." So she bought me a trumpet, she almost had to whip me to make me put the trumpet down. So when Margie saw that I was improving more, then she started practicing. And then my sister got the alto sax and she
was playing. But all three of us had teachers. Did you have a band with Clarence Ford?

Oh yeah, yeah. That's when I came out of the service. We had also created by Dizzy Gillespie and Charlie Parker. I called all the old musicians up whom I played with and told them I didn't want to play with them no more. That's because the music you're playing is old, that's out of style. I'm playing bebop now. So Clarence Ford, we graduated from high school together. From Booker T. Washington? Yeah, same class. And Wilbur Hogan too. Did you have him? Yeah. Wilbur Hogan? Yeah. We graduated together.
